description: Model-free Rust known-answer lane for R4KV profile accounting, codec round trips, page identity, and corruption rejection.
quant_name: R4KV public profiles REF-A, BASE-Q8, P-K6V4, P-K4V4, P-K4V3
quant_format_version: public Rust R4KV profile and codec definitions
os: not required for the result; Cargo/Rust host
rust: workspace Rust implementation; no foreign inference runtime
kv_format: R4KV profile codecs and page envelope
raw_output_digest: recorded in sanitized_receipt.json fields source_vector_sha256 and page body_sha256

tolerance.codec: exact structural gates plus reported floating-point error
tolerance.proxy_kl: descriptive only; no quality threshold asserted

known_limitations: No model weights or tokenizer are used.
Synthetic proxy KL is not perplexity or attention quality.
No GPU parity or end-to-end generation result is claimed.
Quality-frontier receipts from private model runs are not represented by this KAT.
